imports: source04 original completion semantics and original clock bounds, without old path Ref

TestStream2.utf8: String bounded by selected parser maximum

producer_consumer.selection_inventory: Externally selected freeze reviewer declares exact command/parser/source inventory and expected IDs/counts after complete source freeze, before any group starts.
producer_consumer.observation: Measurement completion.py owns subprocess capture, raw streams and observed reports under the independently appointed completion-observer role.
producer_consumer.verifier: Custody-owned source/custody_runtime/completion_verifier.py validates independently selected records and actual capture/report/collection equivalence. It does not generate observations or choose expected counts from observed results.
producer_consumer.issuer: Custody release_issuer consumes the authentic CompletionReceipt2 only after independently revalidating the verifier result and all original clock bindings.

required_rules: Exactly13 groups in group_order, each once, no extra/missing/duplicate/subset and no reordered group substitution. Groups contracts through operational-custody use PYTHON_METHODS; node-version uses NODE_VERSION; ui uses NODE_TAP.

Every frozen test source file is assigned exactly once in SourceInventory. This includes every added integration test, not only the historical B10 list. Expected collection IDs/counts are frozen independently before running; no count is inferred from the app's PASS label or copied from the actual observed count.

CollectionInventory.entries contain unique IDs; expected_count equals entry count and GroupSelection.expected_test_count; test_ids_sha256 hashes canonical sorted ID array. Non-version groups require count>0. Node-version requires empty inventory/count0 and exact pinned expected stdout including newline.

Command SHA256 hashes canonical {executable,argv,cwd,environment_profile_sha256,stdin_policy,source_manifest_sha256,group_id}; exclude command_sha256 itself. No shell substitution, secret argv/env or command selected by a report.

Actual SPAWN then EXIT has one exact PID/start identity and selected command/executable; before/after observation must detect PID reuse. Exit0 alone does not establish completion. Capture and streams must be complete and independently signed/registered; truncation, overflow or unreadable output yields INCOMPLETE.

ParserPin fixes exact parser component, schema, mode and test-ID encoding. Verifier re-parses raw retained streams/framework report, compares every report field and compares collected/executed IDs to the selected inventory; observed collection must equal expected, with no unlisted or omitted test.

Python reports preserve framework counters and add explicit discovered/executed qualified IDs under the reviewed driver; old seven-field reports cannot supply missing IDs by inference. UI requires a pinned TAP parser/report writer that retains full unique test names and exact totals; duplicate names, ambiguous nesting or unavailable membership fail. Node version is never counted as a test.

For non-version groups: discovered=ran=passed=expected_count and both sorted ID sets equal inventory. skipped/failures/errors/cancelled/todo all0. For version group all counts0, IDs empty, exact pinned stdout, exit0. Reports never accept a lower expected count because new integration tests were added.

Group timestamps remain within the original test window and selected validity; groups do not overlap. Source-test completion precedes original model-window start. The completion receipt's completed time equals final group/report finish; all13 report refs and selection binding agree.

Protected record grants must bind command/parser/inventory to freeze-review authority, capture/streams/observed reports to completion-observer, and original source report to custody. Completion verification cannot be delegated to the application PASS label.

All records are source formats. Actual expected inventories/counts for future operational modules remain to be populated at complete source freeze; source examples are not that inventory. No test has been executed here.

All three normalized framework report types are closed above and retained as TEST_FRAMEWORK_REPORT. A pinned parser independently reconstructs them from complete source streams/report files and selected test IDs. For UI, collected IDs require independently captured reviewed runner discovery output as well as TAP results; absent discovery cannot be inferred from the passed tests alone.

Raw streams are capped at512KiB to fit a bounded protected JSON object even with escaping. Exceeding any selected bound yields incomplete evidence, never truncation. Node-version compares exact pinned stdout/stderr; other groups use the selected parser's complete report.

SourceInventory.test_roots are externally frozen and cover every test directory in the complete source package; every matching source file in those roots is assigned once, with no omission/exclusion. New integration files under the integration root therefore change the required inventory. A new test root requires a new reviewed selection before running.

GroupReport2 always includes authenticated TEST_DISCOVERY_REPORT emitted before group execution and captured by the observer. For NODE_VERSION it has an empty ID list. Discovery, selected inventory, actual executed results and selected command/source/parser all agree; a UI TAP pass list alone cannot establish discovery completeness.
